reason: Annealing-induced nanoscale precipitate pinning is a plausible, testable route to higher coercivity, but this paper neither annealed the alloy nor studied precipitate pinning; it instead linked high coercivity primarily to Ti-associated reduction of saturation magnetization and magnetocrystalline anisotropy. The answer key incorrectly introduces dual-phase/interface domain-wall pinning and an orbital-moment contribution that the paper does not establish and partly rejects.
